title: Case
description: ENG-01 new contract for the existing SA object. Source: SA FR-03/UC-01/08.4 (接單或營運案件、需求版、下一步、回覆所有權) 與 ADR 0001 (保留 Case，不被 Work 取代). Case keeps its own container lifecycle only; the detailed in-flight workflow state lives on Work (ADR 0001: Work.status 使用 Work 契約的業務狀態) so Case does not carry a second, competing state machine.

case_type.description: Open classification tag mirroring SA UI-01 filters (接單／客訴／素材／核准／發布). Not an exhaustive enum: new case types are a product decision, not an ENG-01 schema change.

status.description: Container lifecycle only. OPEN means the case can still receive messages, gain new Work, or have its demand revised. Progress/waiting/decision detail is read from the Case's Work objects, not duplicated here.

demand_revision.description: Bumped every time confirmed demand fields change (SA FR-06/FR-11). Invalidates outstanding Quote/CustomerConsent tied to an older demand_revision.

current_owner.description: The single valid reply owner (SA FR-03: AI／真人只有一個有效回覆擁有者).

next_step.description: SA UI-01 必備資訊：下一步、等待誰、期限。

conversation_refs.description: Conversations linked to this Case via CASE_CONVERSATION (SD work-execution-contract.md §1 ERD). Persistence of the join table is ENG-02 scope; this field only fixes the reference shape.

complaint_refs.description: Complaints opened against this Case. A Case is not itself a complaint (ADR 0001); this is an optional 0..N relation.

work_refs.description: Works accepted under this Case. A Case commonly has multiple concurrent Works (quote/booking, reschedule, notification, material intake, catalog revision) per SD work-execution-contract.md §1. This array is a convenience projection; Work.case_id is the authoritative link.
